chunks: Ibn Mahbub narrated from 'Ali ibn Ri'ab, from Buraid al-'Ijli, who said:
I asked Aba 'Abd Allah عليه السلام about a Muslim who gouged out the eye of a Christian, and he said: “Indeed, the blood money for the eye of a dhimmi is four hundred dirhams.”

key_terms.أَرْبَعُمِائَةِ دِرْهَمٍ: four hundred dirhams, the specified compensation amount
key_terms.دِيَةَ عَيْنِ الذِّمِّيِّ: the legal blood money compensation for the eye of a protected non-Muslim

ai.seo_question: What is the diyyah for the eye of a dhimmi if a Muslim injures it?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning bodily injury inflicted by a Muslim upon a protected non-Muslim. Imam Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام states that the diyyah for the eye of a dhimmi is four hundred dirhams, establishing a specific compensation amount in fiqh.
